note: The rule tree: stages are read top-down. A change enters at the highest stage whose inputs it touches; every stage below it is checked again. A failing stage makes every stage below it provisional: revise the highest failing stage first.

principles.en: Read the tree top-down: sources → thread → paragraphs → sentences → format → the rule system itself.
principles.zh: 自上而下读规则树：源头 → 主线 → 段落 → 句子 → 格式 → 规则系统本身。

principles.en: Revise at the highest failing stage; rewriting a sentence is wasted when its paragraph or claim will change.
principles.zh: 在最高的未通过层修改；段落或主张将改动时，不要先改句子。

principles.en: Every rule sits in the tree exactly once (rule R0); every testable rule must catch its own test sentences (rule R1).
principles.zh: 每条规则在树中只出现一次（规则R0）；每条可测试的规则须抓住自己的测试句（规则R1）。
